column1: # Mutants for scripts/mutation-check.sh. Columns are separated by one TAB:

column5: L3 also rejects reads in the issue cycle
L6 rejects operations that complete exactly at HALT
L8 treats a store as visible from the cycle after issue
LD commits with the ST latency
SUB computes a sum (values only; verdicts unchanged)
rs1 and rs2 swap places in the encoding
RTL MUL commits with the ADD latency
RTL reads rs1 in place of rs2
RTL writes a load one cycle late
L9 accepts an issue one cycle inside the II
L10 is missed for store latencies above 1
the model lets a load read a word being stored
